scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
scripts.db:bootstrap: docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml exec -T postgres sh /opt/dayorder/bootstrap-roles.sh
scripts.config:db:preflight: confighub run --project shier --env prod -- go run ./apps/api/cmd/bootstrap -preflight
scripts.config:db:bootstrap: confighub run --project shier --env prod -- go run ./apps/api/cmd/bootstrap
scripts.config:db:check: confighub run --project shier --env prod -- go run ./apps/api/cmd/migrate -check
scripts.config:dev:api: confighub run --project shier --env prod -- go run ./apps/api/cmd/server
scripts.config:dev:worker: confighub run --project shier --env prod -- go run ./apps/api/cmd/worker

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
